# Troubleshooting

## The status LED is blinking amber

A blinking amber LED means the router has power but no WAN connection. Check the
cable between the WAN port and the modem, then restart the modem before the router.

## Error E-105

Error E-105 is shown when the firmware update could not be verified. Retry the
update over a wired connection. If it fails twice, the unit must be returned.

## Factory reset

Hold the recessed reset button for 10 seconds while the unit is powered on. A
factory reset erases every setting, including the Wi-Fi password.
